get_model: create a Wikimedia_Data_Fetcher instance from a parameters dict containing path_to_candidate_data_dict
init_Wikimedia_Data_Fetcher: initialize a Wikimedia_Data_Fetcher by loading a pickled candidate data dictionary from a file path
get_data_for_entity: enrich an entity data dict with wikidata aliases and up to ten description sentences
filter_emoji_aliases: use get_data_for_entity to retrieve entity aliases that exclude unicode emoji characters
extract_description_sentences: extract up to ten description sentences for a wikipedia entity title from candidate data
